title: Prime spectrum of a locally constant function ring
statement: Use the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological space and $R$ a commutative ring, and write $\operatorname{LC}(S,R)$ for the ring of locally constant functions $S\to R$ with pointwise operations. There is a homeomorphism $S\times\operatorname{Spec}R\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Spec}\operatorname{LC}(S,R)$ of underlying topological spaces [def-weil-affine-spectrum], sending $(s,\mathfrak p)$ to the prime ideal $\{h:h(s)\in\mathfrak p\}$. This includes the empty space and the zero ring.
